profile.headline: Configuration Manager at Hansen Technologies
profile.summary: A Technical Fellow, with 20 years of experience developing, collaborating, and writing high quality software for the Financial Industry. I have strong analytical and collaborative skills, that I have honed over the years; from mentoring junior developers on how to solve technical problems and read specifications, to collaborating with management on why they should go with one 3rd party solution instead of another.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Configuration Manager 2024 through Present
positions.description:
2026 — Platform Automation & MCP Stack Governance
•	Expanded platform-wide build and process automation to support operational scale and reduce manual intervention.
•	Restored missing database artifacts to source control and CI pipelines, eliminating environment drift across deployments.
•	Contributed architectural improvements to the Hansen CCB MCP AI solution, increasing cross-component integration stability. We are just beginning our AI journey.
•	Unified server, configuration, and query-tool integrations to enforce consistent access-control policies across the MCP stack.

2025 — Kubernetes Adoption (Technical Lead)
•	Defined technical direction and execution strategy for Kubernetes adoption across platform services.
•	Evolved deployment patterns to enable containerized runtime consistency, scalability, and operational resilience.
•	Restructured build and release workflows to support Kubernetes-native delivery models.
•	Closed a critical security gap in configuration packaging and deployment processes.

2024 — GitHub Enterprise Migration (Lead Engineer)
•	Directed migration to GitHub with PR-based delivery and unified CI/CD workflows across active branches.
•	Orchestrated branch synchronization and production cutover to minimize delivery disruption.
•	Instituted organization-wide review and merge practices that improved code quality and collaboration velocity.
•	Architected a service-oriented build execution model (OWIN-based service and Windows client), replacing unreliable command-line execution patterns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Configuration Manager 2020 through 2023
positions.description:
2023 —.NET Framework to ASP.NET Core Migration (Technical Lead)
•	Guided platform migration from .NET Framework to ASP.NET Core, establishing modernization standards and sequencing strategy.
•	Introduced dependency injection, middleware, and request-pipeline best practices across teams.
•	Adapted build and packaging systems for .NET Core compatibility.
•	Resolved cross-branch regressions and tooling instability during transition.
•	Improved artifact consistency to increase deployment predictability and reduce release defects.

2022 — Build System Modernization & Secure Tooling
•	Transitioned from Visual Build to a fully automated MSBuild-first pipeline architecture, eliminating manual build dependencies.
•	Reinforced release integrity through deterministic builds, strong-name signing enforcement, and dependency alignment (.NET 4.8).
•	Modernized licensing workflows by rewriting the License Manager WPF application.
•	Delivered a secure Blazor-based back-office application enabling authorized support personnel to decrypt protected client credentials under controlled access policies.

2021 — Dual Database Platform Expansion
•	Contributed to project to architectural support for both PostgreSQL and Oracle within the platform.
•	Harmonized schema definitions and migration patterns to reduce engine-specific divergence.
•	Built parameterized database build, import, and export workflows for CI and local environments.
•	Assisted cross-engine test pipeline evolution and rollout stabilization.

2020 — TFVC to Git Migration & CI Evolution
•	Transitioned engineering workflows from TFVC to distributed Git-based development.
•	Re-engineered CI pipelines to support pull-request validation, automated gating, and improved parallelization.
•	Built a multithreaded database provisioning tool to eliminate CI instability caused by Oracle lock contention.
•	Reduced concurrency-related failures in automated database creation workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Configuration Manager 2015 through 2019
positions.description:
2019 — AWS Cloud Migration (Principal Engineer)
•	Directed end-to-end migration from on-premises infrastructure to AWS across application, database, and release systems.
•	Shaped architectural decisions to minimize cutover risk and maintain production continuity.
•	Coordinated cross-team migration dependencies and execution sequencing.
•	Stabilized post-migration operations within AWS-hosted environments.
*       Increased threading of database creation scripts, the newly created AWS Oracle databases were pluggable, which made them slower for creation and destruction compared to the previous version.

2017 — Release Pipeline Reliability & Infrastructure Hardening
•	Increased release pipeline stability by resolving recurring infrastructure-sensitive test failures.
•	Corrected Oracle client compatibility issues impacting licensing and automated testing flows.
•	Maintained version and update script progression to support predictable release cadence.
•	Reduced intermittent test failures in infrastructure-sensitive scenarios.
•	Improved release verification confidence with targeted maintenance work.
•    Enhanced build performance by implementing multi-threading and developing a custom MSBuild Task

2016 — Platform Identifier Expansion Initiative
•	Implemented expanded reference-number support across device and PSM paths.
•	Refactored build and migration scripts post-rollout to eliminate regressions.
•	Corrected migration-related edge cases introduced during platform transition.
•	Improved release packaging reliability tied to identifier-range updates.

2015 — Core Billing Stabilization & Upgrade Foundations
•	Built and maintained database versioning and migration frameworks to improve release predictability.
•	Resolved lifecycle defects across product cancellation and scheduling flows.
•	Improved account and document retrieval reliability in core billing scenarios.
•	Reduced deployment risk by cleaning legacy upgrade paths and standardizing migration scripts.
positions.insights: C#, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +2 skills

positions.title: Install Shield Developer
positions.description:
* Significantly decreased the calls volume to Technical Support:
      Before my employment at Financial profiles, 70% of technical support calls were for install related problems.  By making the installer more robust and less error prone, I was able to reduce the call volume for install related problems to 10% of total call volume. This was a huge cost saving to Financial Profiles. The way I did this was by adding logging to the installer so problems were  easier to pin point and also slimmed down the number of use cases the install catered for. 

* Modified and maintained the build systems for multiple web and desktop applications.
* Implemented a C++ Install library that was used by both the Wise and InstallShield Installers.
       The library had the following functionality: 
              Updated XML File, 
              Manipulated Zip files using the Xceed zip Library 
              Start and Stop windows services. 
              Manipulated InstallShield com objects.

* Implemented the functionality  to configure multiple web sites on one windows 2003  server 
* Added the functionality to the installers to update Zip files using the Xceed Zip library
* Created use cases and other design specification documentation relating to installers, using the
     Ration Rose Documentation Process
* Designed and implemented a robust  and  easily maintainable installation system 
* Wrote an MFC application to resolve VB COM registry problems found in the field.. 
* Moved the build process from Ant to more easily maintained Visual Build system
* Created service packs using the Wise Installer System for both desktop and Web Applications

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
At SAIC, I started as a Senior Developer and was later promoted to a Lead Developer of the CATS project, a GIS based product for DTRA. CATS is a system based on ESRI GIS software to model the damage created by a man made or natural threat. An example problem for CATS to solve would be: a pipe bombs explodes next to a school how many casualties will be affected and what are the areas that should be cordoned off.  CATS has been used  at both the Greek and Utah Olympic to assess the threats of a terrorist attacks. 

Management responsibilities
Mentored and taught junior developers, good development practices. Help them to understand specifications

Finding eloquent solutions to complex problems. 
An Example of this would be creating a framework for other DTRA parties to add their software to ArcGIS as buttons on the task bar. In ArcGIS every button must be pre-created, there was no way to create them at runtime. To get around this problem I created a grab bag of 1000 buttons.

* Configuration manager (Created a build process for all JAVA/C++/VB code with visual build.)
* Wrote a SMTP Email Client Object using ATL/COM 
* Wrote an ATL COM object to Use BASE 64 encoding to encode and decode strings
* Designed and maintained reports built in Crystal Reports
* Designed and wrote a Win Socks Client and Server to make communication possible between JAVA and Visual Basic applications
* Created a Service to consume weather sensor information in XML format and plot the information in an ESRI GIS 
* Created Utilities to Maintain Multiple SQL Servers and MSDE Databases.
* Created an ATL COM C++ threaded Progress Bar object for displaying Progress of Application Activities 
* Created an NT Service to Maintain Java CORBA services. 
* Designed and implemented a preference application and object to maintain registry settings and allowed for other applications to access these same settings.

projects.title: Geo-Beacon
projects.description: A windows phone application to let others know when a device enter or leaves a certain geo graphic area

projects.title: Galactic Flashlight
projects.description: Collaborated with Matthew Torch to create a simple windows phone flashlight application, which incorporates  a Flashlight, a Strobe Light, an SOS Light, and a Compass
